title: CatalogMetadata
responsibility: Stores catalog schema versions and source digests in catalog_metadata through a supplied persistence adapter.

outputs.name: CatalogMetadata.find

outputs.description: Promise of the updated catalog_metadata row, or null according to the adapter update result.

outputs.name: CatalogMetadata.delete
outputs.description: Promise of the adapter deletion result for the requested catalog_metadata row.

errors.description: Adapter exceptions and promise rejections pass through unchanged; caller-provided field getters can also throw during argument copying.
